items: Land on the treehouse deck and press F (or the Bedroom button) to go back to your room mid-night: change your look, hat and broom while the world runs ten times slower
'Back to the island' (where the party scroll was) takes you back to the deck
Leave a hat lying somewhere and fetch a new one from your room: the old one stays where it is, still working its spell, and you can have several out at once
You can only pick up a hat from the ground when you aren't wearing one: put yours down first
Every hat you've left out gets its own pointer, its hat in that hat's colour, and keeps the look it had when you put it down
